summary: Adds .github/workflows/e2e.yml with three parallel jobs (docker-e2e, kubernetes-e2e, systemd-e2e) triggered on push to main and pull_request with path filters matching cmd/**, internal/**, deploy/**, test/e2e/**, Dockerfile, and the workflow itself. Each job uses pinned action SHAs matching existing workflows, Go 1.24, timeout-minutes 30, and captures/uploads container logs as artifacts on failure. Makefile targets test-e2e-k8s and test-e2e-systemd added alongside existing test-e2e-docker. Reference documentation at docs/reference/backend/e2e-workflow.md covers triggers, jobs, artifact debugging, and action versions.

tests_checklist.item: E2E test scripts exist and are invoked via Makefile targets
Workflow triggers match spec path filters exactly
Log capture uses correct container names/namespaces from test scripts

code_quality_checklist.item: Follows existing workflow conventions (SHA pinning, step naming, timeout)
Three jobs run in parallel with no needs: dependencies
Makefile targets follow existing test-e2e-docker pattern

security_checklist.item: All actions pinned to full SHA (not mutable tags)
No secrets or credentials exposed in workflow
No command injection vectors in workflow steps

architecture_checklist.item: Solution is as simple as possible — single workflow file with three parallel jobs
Path filters avoid wasting CI minutes on unrelated changes
Artifact upload on failure enables debugging without re-running

dry_yagni_checklist.item: No duplicated configuration beyond necessary per-job setup

fail_fast_checklist.item: Each log capture step uses || true to handle already-cleaned-up resources

defensive_checklist.item: Log capture protected with || true for cases where test cleanup already ran
Both if: failure() on capture and upload ensures artifacts only created on failure
